villageLost.beat: Haven couldn't hold. On the fifth hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.

deathDayLines.line: — DAY 18 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

🔥 Abigail has been turning something over all evening. Finally: “Terrence. The past story — we all eat from the same pot here, we don’t get to lie about who’s at it.” It costs Abigail to say it; you can see the price land.

Terrence is quiet for a long moment. Then, all in a rush: “Fine. It’s true. Not Denver — Columbus, Ohio. I lied because the truth felt small.” The admission hangs there, and the village — to its credit — doesn’t pounce.
People bring you their suspicions, written down. You keep every one.
Eric Melnyk reads the sky: clear tomorrow, cold.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
Dawn. You wake rested. (+0 health, energy restored. Your sleeping body burned less — 401 kcal conserved. By the fire. Good enough.)
You chew the bitter leaves. Folk say it helps — you wouldn't know. (+2 health, maybe)

The relief moment passes — the crisis runs its own course now. What you did stands; what you didn't, doesn't.

Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. 📝 SYSTEM NOTE: "The tubers did not scream. Our models predicted screaming. The models have been updated. You are welcome."
